inputs.label: Findings draft
inputs.content:
Results we have:
R1: FedSpec 74.8% vs FedAvg 71.2% top-1 accuracy on CIFAR-10, one run.

Findings:
F1: FedSpec achieves higher accuracy than FedAvg on CIFAR-10.
F2: FedSpec converges faster than FedAvg.
F3: FedSpec is more robust to client dropout.
F4: FedSpec reduces communication cost.

We did not measure convergence speed, client dropout, or communication cost.
